description: Use when you need a transaction by hash on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Polygon or Optimism: from, to, value, nonce, gas and fee fields, block, confirmations, method id and input (first 1 KB). Returns the paid x402 request for your input (GET /evm/tx, $0.002 per call; schema linked). Call that URL with an x402 or MPP client to get the data. Bad input is refused before any charge. Raw transaction fields (from, to, value, input); to know whether it succeeded (status, gas used, logs) use evm_receipt; to check a payment amount use pay_check. With an access key (Authorization: Bearer p0k_..., buy at https://x402-bazaar-rank.x402-bazaar-rank-worker.workers.dev/keys/buy?usd=5) the tool pays the call itself, returns the data and deducts the price. First call each day returns the data itself, free; later calls return the paid request.

chain.description: Chain to look the transaction up on; default base

hash.description: Transaction hash (0x + 64 hex); looked up on the chosen chain only; not found there: refused before any charge
